actions.rationale: Flat sidecar; deploy half of the $100m gross cap in the isolated AU-versus-CA spot cross. Size is capped below full allocation because carry opposes (164.9bp 2Y / 206bp overnight) and CA labor is weak, but SOFR 3.85% vig on the undeployed remainder still favors putting on a defined-invalidation expression rather than staying 100% cash.

events.invalidation: Housing channel reverses, BoC energy risk is withdrawn and CORRA hikes are priced out while AUDCAD holds the packet 5y extreme.
events.rationale: VERIFIED FACT: AUDCAD 0.9975768872320596 as of 2026-09-18 sits at 5y percentile 99.96 / z 2.76 while AONIA 4.35 already exceeds CORRA 2.29 by 206bp, AU 2Y is 4.999% versus CA 2Y 3.35% on 2026-09-16 (-164.9bp CA-AU), Australian housing is contracting on stamp-duty, volumes and prices, Canada’s core is near 2% with headline at 3%, and CORRA 3m still prices +84bp by Mar-2027 versus AONIA +51bp to 4.86. INFERENCE: USD expressions (short AUDUSD or long USDCAD) own Fed/USD/oil beta that both commodity currencies share; the residual that is actually extreme is AUD versus CAD. Spot is mapping a known carry advantage into a 5-year high after the RBA tightening channel has started to bite and while Canada still has the larger remaining implied hike path plus energy pass-through risk. UNKNOWN: NZ official yields, CA official zero curve, CME positioning, broker executables, and whether Saudi STS supply fully offsets BoC energy-pass-through. Fade AUDCAD, do not own USD.
